reason: The linux_riscv64_ CI job fails solely because the solver cannot find cross-python_linux-riscv64. This is a missing infrastructure dependency, not a feedstock bug. All other platforms (linux_64, linux_aarch64, linux_ppc64le, win_64, osx_64, osx_arm64) pass. No action is needed on the PR itself; the fix must come from the cross-python riscv64 package being available in the conda-forge channel.
